intro.body: I'm Riyad, a CSE graduate and Full Stack Software Engineer specializing in Python and JavaScript. I design and build systems from scratch to deployment — clean, scalable, and production-ready. With 1000+ problems solved and 70+ contests under my belt, I bring strong problem-solving thinking to everything I build. I'm always ready for the next challenge.
